description: A container for one of your customers, with its own sending reputation. Give it a `name` a person would recognise and, if your own system has an id for this customer, `client_id` — carried and returned, never parsed. Then pass the new pod’s id as `pod_id` to `create_address`. There is no delete: a pod holds mailboxes, and the verb that destroys hundreds of them at once is not one to hand an agent.
name: create_pod
title: Make a pod
